hero.h1: Optimize Textile Production with Smart Maintenance
hero.lead: Reduce machine downtime, digitize maintenance workflows and get full visibility of your textile operations with a single connected platform.
hero.social_proof: Trusted by more than 200 textile teams worldwide

challenges.sub: Textile plants face avoidable delays and quality losses when maintenance is disconnected from production priorities.
challenges.card1_p: Unplanned breakdowns disrupt production and create costly bottlenecks on critical lines.
challenges.card2_p: Paper logs and spreadsheets make task tracking slow, error-prone and hard to audit.
challenges.card3_p: Teams struggle to detect wear patterns without real-time status and historical context.

solution.sub: From machine data to maintenance execution, TexCheck connects the entire cycle in a single operational view.
solution.b1_p: Track live performance and condition trends to prevent failures before they escalate.
solution.b2_p: Log interventions, parts and technical notes in a searchable maintenance history.
solution.b3_p: Automate recurring tasks and trigger work orders based on operational cycles and thresholds.
solution.b4_p: Unify plant KPIs so maintenance and operations can prioritize with confidence.

features.sub: Everything your maintenance team needs to operate with fewer stops and greater control.
features.f1_p: Live status, usage and condition signals in one consolidated operational stream.
features.f2_p: Coordinate recurring and corrective tasks with calendar views and smart assignment.
features.f3_p: Log incidents, root causes and corrective actions to reduce repeated disruptions.
features.f4_p: Measure MTBF, MTTR, compliance and load trends to optimize your maintenance strategy.

about.h2: We build technology that keeps textile plants moving
about.p1: TexCheck was born from a reality we saw first-hand: maintenance teams in the textile industry still rely on paper, phone calls and guesswork. We decided to change that.
about.p2: We are a team of engineers, designers and industrial specialists united by the conviction that textile manufacturing deserves tools as smart as its operations. Our platform connects people, machines and data so that maintenance stops being reactive and becomes a competitive advantage.
about.v1_p: We design for real technicians, in real plants.
about.v2_p: Implementation in days, results from the first week.
about.v3_p: Your operational data is yours. Always.
about.quote: "Our mission is simple: no textile plant should lose production for lack of information."

product.ph1_p: Create, assign and close WOs from any device.
product.ph4_p: Notifications based on thresholds and operating cycles.

team.sub: Professionals passionate about technology and the textile industry, building the maintenance platform of the future together.

benefits.h2: Benefits that impact your operation from day one
benefits.b1_p: Reduce production interruptions by up to 35% with automated preventive maintenance and early alerts based on real machine data.
benefits.b2_p: Eliminate paper and spreadsheets. All orders, checklists and histories in one place, accessible from any device.
benefits.b3_p: Real-time KPI dashboards: MTBF, MTTR, compliance and trends. Your management team makes better decisions with reliable information.
benefits.b4_p: No complex installations. TexCheck runs in the cloud and can be adopted by your team in days, not months.
benefits.b5_p: Connect technicians, supervisors and managers on one platform so everyone works toward the same goal.
benefits.b6_p: Every intervention, part and failure is recorded. Audits, warranties and root-cause analysis at the click of a button.
